omu0: Usually not; most shoulder tip injuries heal with a sling, exercises and physiotherapy. Surgery may be considered in some cases where the ligaments are badly torn and the joint is clearly separated. After surgery the sling is usually worn for 6 weeks, and returning to contact sports takes about 12 weeks. A 2019 Cochrane review of six studies did not show that surgery gives better results than non-surgical treatment in adults; most side effects occurred in the surgery groups.
